_note: How the Weltbauer's merged ground looks in the editor and in the game (src/world_editor/world_terrain.gd). pit: colours of a pit, per world, where neighbouring pit cells form one hole: void = inside, face = the far wall seen inside the hole, face_px = its height, rim = lit edge, rim_px = its width, grain = share of edge pixels that break the straight line. area: an area brush keeps its tile running across cells and only its outer edge gets edge (colour) over edge_px, grain as above. pad: the Sprungplatte's chevrons, idle = dim colour, live = bright colour, base = plate tint.
